correctness.rationale: Exact height parity and total zero-count identities reduce every prefix-normal inequality to truncated sum closure. Construct inverse semigroup path maps for every n≥1. Genus, area, first return/multiplicity and last lifted vertex/conductor are proved. Pairing across Frobenius gap yields conductor ≤2g; <2,2g+1> realizes equality. Standalone 16,383-path independent direct test confirms small cases; this is not used as an infinite proof.
